proof.text: Construct the open cover from the pieces. Any family of scheme maps on the pieces agrees on overlaps: for equal indices use monicity of the open inclusion; for distinct indices disjointness makes the pullback empty and hence initial. Glue the maps and use open-cover hom_ext for uniqueness. This works for arbitrary index universes, including empty pieces and the empty base.

title: Coproduct of a clopen decomposition
statement: Let X be a scheme, R a type, and U : R → X.Opens a clopen decomposition. Then the inclusions of the open pieces form a scheme coproduct: Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk X (fun r : R ↦ (U r).ι))).

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocalSystemsType_coproduct (X : Scheme.{t}) (R : Type v)
    (U : R → X.Opens) (hU : IsClopenDecomposition X R U) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (Cofan.mk X (fun r : R ↦ (U r).ι)))
